title: Truchas 2D coupled flow-thermal solver
description: Coupled flow-thermal solver controls. The flow and thermal subobjects configure their respective implicit solves; the time-step controls apply to the coupled integrator.

initial-time-step.description: Initial coupled time-step size. It must be strictly positive.

min-time-step.description: Smallest permitted coupled time-step size. It must be strictly positive and no greater than initial-time-step.

max-time-step.description: Largest permitted coupled time-step size. It must be at least initial-time-step; if omitted, the implementation uses an effectively unbounded maximum.

time-step-growth.description: Maximum factor by which a successful coupled time step may grow the next time step. The default is 1.05.

time-step-lookahead.description: Number of future output synchronization points considered when selecting a coupled step. The default is three.

max-try-at-step.description: Maximum number of attempts made to accept one coupled time step. The default is 10.

inertial.description: Include transient and convective momentum terms. Set false for non-inertial Stokes flow. Inviscid flow requires this setting to remain true.

courant-number.description: Courant number used to limit the flow time step. It must be greater than zero and no greater than one; the default is 0.5.

volume-tracking.description: Optional controls for material volume-fraction transport.

momentum-solver.description: HYPRE hybrid controls for the implicit momentum solve. Required for viscous flow and omitted for inviscid flow.

projection-solver.description: HYPRE hybrid controls for the pressure-projection solve. This sublist is required.
